extracted.name: Easy Pineapple Pie
extracted.description: This pie is creamy, light and delicious. Condensed milk, whipped topping, crushed pineapple and lemon juice are all stirred and folded together to make a divine filling that everyone will think you spent hours making in the kitchen.
ingredient_lines: 1 (8 ounce) container frozen whipped topping, thawed
instruction_lines: Whisk sweetened condensed milk and lemon juice together in a large bowl until smooth and slightly thickened. Fold in crushed pineapple and whipped topping until evenly combined.
Spoon filling into the prepared graham cracker crust; smooth the top. Refrigerate until set, at least 2 hours, before serving.
